attacks.name: Earth-Shaker
steps: After each attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Stun|: After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Hurricane Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Push|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 2 or less, this character may Push it Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Hydrokinesis
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Slow|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition.

attacks.name: Volcanic Surge
steps: After each attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Incinerate|: After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

superPowers.name: Elemental Onslaught
superPowers.body: After an attack made by this character during its Activation is resolved, it may use this superpower. This character makes an attack action and must choose an attack it has not used yet this Activation. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Elemental Empowerment
superPowers.body: Enemy characters making a Shake action while within |!range| 3 of this character may not remove the |§incinerate§Incinerate|, |§slow§Slow|, or |§stun§Stun| special conditions.

superPowers.name: Inhuman
superPowers.body: This character may reroll 1 die in its attack or defense rolls.
